overview: You tried to give the objection from last night, that a twelvemonth and a day is too long for a play, and you struck it as too bald. You left a rougher line under it and left the messenger's half-line empty. You did not write a song. You did not write the last line. The comedy is not finished.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Struck two lines and left the half-line empty.

parties.name: Richard Burbage
parties.context: Not in the room. The struck phrase is the one he gave you last night.

assets.name: Love's Labour's Lost
assets.disposition: Struck the bald line and wrote a shorter one

summary: Struck the bald line and wrote a shorter one
